description: Closes two gaps in results_cascade.tex flagged in TODO.md (found 2026-09-29 auditing Results). (a) Medverse 'matched' column (depth-matched native-AR) for the 4 lesion datasets added to tab:cascade-medverse (isles22, shifts_ms, atlas_v2, gnc_kidney) -- previously only their Cascade and Medverse-native values existed (from 2b_cascade_val / 2c_cascade_medverse). Depth M taken from the ACTUAL cascade ladder already in the published Cascade column (verified against 2b_cascade_val/runs.json, which corrected an earlier wrong assumption in TODO.md that shifts_ms/atlas_v2 used 3-level ladders): isles22 [3,1.5] M=2, shifts_ms [3,1.5] M=2, atlas_v2 [3.8,1.9] M=2, gnc_kidney [6,3,1.2] M=3. image_size = 128*2^(M-1) (same formula 3c_synthetic_cascade used for its own M=1/2/3 rows), same recipe as those depth-matched runs (eval.autocast=true, eval.batch_size=2, eval.workers=8, released Medverse weights, no finetune) -- confirmed via wandb-metadata.json of 3c_synthetic_cascade's own medverse_depthmatched_* runs (dhcqbyr0/yxbrv35m/0mbk5mi3): no eval.sw_overlap override (stays at config default 0.1). (b) TotalSeg CT/MRI: tab:cascade-levels/tab:cascade-medverse/tab:cascade-ablation all reported TotalSeg CT/MRI numbers for both Cascade and Medverse that traced to no archived run (the only 2a_cascade touch used a 2-level [4,1.5] ladder at ~78ms/sample, not the tables' claimed 3-level [6,3,1.5] at 278/306ms/sample; Medverse's 'matched' cells were equally untraceable since 3c_synthetic_cascade explicitly scopes TotalSeg CT/MRI out). Replaced with 3 fresh runs per dataset: our checkpoint 146 (146_cascade_randomfg_predprior_regoff, wandb wrwzs5fs, best.pt at 3d_train/2026-09-24_146_cascade_randomfg_predprior_regoff/best.pt) run via eval.py experiment=146_cascade_randomfg_predprior_regoff with data.source=totalseg|totalsegmri data.cascade_spacings=[6,3,1.5] data.mask_downsample=occupancy data.val_classes=all train.cascade_loss_weights=[1,1,1] (NOT cascade.py -- that's a library module used BY eval.py/train.py, not a standalone script, a wrong assumption in an earlier TODO.md draft); Medverse matched (image_size=384, M=3, matching our ladder) and Medverse native (image_size=256, the standard used for every other native row) on the same two sources, data.val_classes=all forced explicitly on all 3 variants for a genuinely apples-to-apples class set (dataset=totalseg's own default is val_classes=benchmark, a subset; dataset=totalseg_mri's own default is val_classes=val, also a subset). data.p_synth=0 required explicitly for dataset=totalseg (its own yaml defaults to p_synth=1, an old seeds3d-synth trap unrelated to synth_gmm -- see docs' eval_totalseg_psynth_gotcha note); dataset=totalseg_mri is already p_synth=0 by default. data.source=totalsegmri (NOT totalseg_mri, a wrong token in an earlier TODO.md draft -- confirmed via common.py's _source_root, which only recognizes the no-underscore token) needed for the 146-checkpoint eval.py override (dataset GROUP names and data.source VALUES differ: the group file is totalseg_mri.yaml but it sets data.source: totalsegmri internally). Run 2026-09-29/30, nora-odin (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell). 8 of 10 runs finished cleanly. medverse_depthmatched_totalseg and medverse_native_totalseg (both `dataset=totalseg` + medverse, i.e. the OLD v1 TotalSegInContextDataset loader) never completed: first attempt hit a real bug (eval.workers=8 -> 'TypeError: cannot pickle module object' under the v1 loader's forkserver multiprocessing start method -- eval.workers=0 is the known workaround, same class of issue as the eval CUDA fork crash noted elsewhere); the eval.workers=0 retry was killed mid-run (crashed, not failed) by an unrelated session/environment teardown before it could finish (3 separate wandb attempts: he9sznty failed, 2b2lce79 crashed, pyubou99 crashed -- none produced a Mean Dice). Not re-attempted in this pass; TotalSeg CT medverse matched/native cells remain open (see TODO.md).
